fluffychat.description:
FluffyChat is a free, open-source instant messenger built on the decentralized Matrix communication protocol. Designed with a friendly Material You interface, it makes private messaging, group conversations, and community communication accessible across Android, iOS, desktop, and the web.

Send text messages, photos, videos, files, voice messages, stickers, and reactions. Create private and public group chats, organize communities using Matrix Spaces, discover public rooms, and communicate with people using other compatible Matrix clients.

FluffyChat supports end-to-end encrypted conversations, encrypted chat backups, cross-signing, and emoji-based device verification. Additional features include Matrix RTC voice and video calls, multiple-device synchronization, customizable themes, push notifications, and advanced room moderation.

Unlike centralized messaging platforms, Matrix lets you choose a homeserver or host your own, giving you greater control over your communication infrastructure.

FluffyChat is developed by an open-source community and distributed under the GNU Affero General Public License. A Matrix account and an internet connection are required. Encryption and calling capabilities may depend on room configuration and server support.
